info.name: jev-vllm /v1/systemone
info.description: Structured reads against jev-vllm (djev + DiffusionGemma on vLLM). Set baseUrl, e.g. after `kubectl -n jev-vllm port-forward svc/djev 8011:8011`. https://github.com/umianta/jev-vllm

request.description: Smallest structured read: one noul (yes/no) question, one probability back.
The same question as ordinary chat, passed straight through to vLLM: slower, and returns text.
